title: SI Controller
text: 使用驾驶员扭矩请求的火花点火发动机控制器，输入 16 路、输出 8 路；按 {Torque table load breakpoints, f_tq_nl_l_bpt} 指定断点 [0.2 0.275 0.35 0.425 0.5 0.575 0.65 0.725 0.8 0.875 0.95 1.025 1.1 1.175；{Air mass flow estimation model} 指定空气质量流量估计模型 Dual Variable Cam、{Torque estimation model} 指定扭矩估计模型 Torque、{Engine commanded load table, f_lcmd} 查找表 array、{Torque command breakpoints, f_lcmd_tq_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_lcmd_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Throttle area percent, f_tap} 查找表，% array、{Throttle area percent load breakpoints, f_tap_ld_bpt} 指定断点、{Throttle area percent speed breakpoints, f_tap_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Throttle area percent to position percent table, f_tpp} 查找表、{Throttle area percent to position percent area breakpoints, f_tpp_tap_bpt} 指定断点、{Wastegate area percent, f_wap} 查找表，% array、{Load breakpoints, f_wap_ld_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_wap_n_bpt} 指定断点，单位为 rpm、{Intake cam phaser angle, f_icp} 查找表 array、{Exhaust cam phaser angle, f_ecp} 查找表 array、{Load breakpoints, f_cp_ld_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_cp_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Commanded EGR percent, f_egrpct_cmd} 查找表 array、{Load breakpoints, f_egrpct_ld_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_egrpct_n_bpt} 指定断点、{EGR valve area percent, f_egr_areapct_cmd} 查找表 array、{Open EGR valve standard flow, f_egr_max_stdflow} 指定断点、{Normalized EGR valve standard flow breakpoints, f_egr_areapct_nrmlzdflow_bpt} 指定断点、{EGR valve pressure ratio breakpoints, f_egr_areapct_pr_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Injector slope, Sinj} 指定斜率、{Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, afr_stoich} 指定比值、{Relative air-fuel ratio lambda, f_lamcmd} 指定空燃比、{Load breakpoints, f_lamcmd_ld_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_lamcmd_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Engine startup lambda enrichment delta vs coolant temperature, f_startup_lambda_delta} 查找表、{Engine startup lambda enrichment delta time constant vs coolant temperature, f_startup_lambda_delta_timecnst} 指定 Lambda 时间常数、{Engine startup coolant temperature breakpoints, f_startup_ect_bpt} 指定断点、{Closed-loop feedback} 指定最小化指令 AFR 误差、{Dither} 指定对催化转化效率建模、{Closed-loop fuel proportional gain, ClsdLpFuelPGain} 指定比例增益、{Closed-loop fuel integral gain, ClsdLpFuelIGain} 指定积分增益、{Closed-loop fuel integrator limit, ClsdLpFuelIntgLmt} 指定积分器限值、{Lambda dither amplitude, LambdaDitherAmp} 指定 Amplitude、{Lambda dither frequency, LambdaDitherFrq} 指定频率、{Oxygen sensor stoichiometric reset voltage, O2ResetStoichVoltSen} 指定闭环 AFR 控制、{Oxygen sensor minimum voltage reset, O2ResetMinVoltSen} 指定闭环 AFR 控制、{Oxygen sensor maximum voltage reset, O2ResetMaxVoltSen} 指定闭环 AFR 控制、{Oxygen sensor voltage learn update period, O2LearnUpdatePerSen} 指定闭环 AFR 控制、{Oxygen sensor voltage amplitude minimum, O2AmpMinVoltSen} 指定闭环 AFR 控制、{Oxygen sensor ready voltage, O2ReadyVoltSen} 指定闭环 AFR 控制、{Oxygen sensor not ready voltage, O2NotReadyVoltSen} 指定闭环 AFR 控制、{Spark advance table, f_sa} 查找表 array、{Load breakpoints, f_sa_ld_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_sa_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Target idle speed, N_idle} 指定速度、{Enable torque command limit, Trq_idlecmd_enable} 指定转矩、{Maximum torque command, Trq_idlecmd_max} 指定转矩、{Proportional gain, Kp_idle} 指定 PI 控制器、{Integral gain, Ki_idle} 指定 PI 控制器、{Rev-limiter speed threshold, EngRevLim} 指定发动机转速限制、{Engine cranking speed, CrankSpeed} 指定发动机转速、{Enable Engine Stop-Start} 以启用发动机起停逻辑、{External Enable Port} 指定创建输入端口、{Engine stop time, EngStopTime} 指定发动机停止时间、{Catalyst light off time, CatLightOffTime} 指定催化剂起燃时间、{Sample time, Ts} 指定采样时间、{Number of cylinders, NCyl} 指定发动机气缸数、{Crank revolutions per power stroke, Cps} 指定每冲程转数、{Total displaced volume, Vd} 指定体积、{Ideal gas constant air, Rair} 指定常量、{Air standard pressure, Pstd} 指定压力、{Air standard temperature, Tstd} 指定温度、{Speed-density volumetric efficiency, f_nv} 查找表 array、{Speed-density intake manifold pressure breakpoints, f_nv_prs_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed-density engine speed breakpoints, f_nv_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Cylinder volume at intake valve close table, f_vivc} 指定二维查找表 array、{Engine speed breakpoints, f_tm_corr_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Cylinder volume intake cam phase breakpoints, f_vivc_icp_bpt} 指定断点、{Cylinder trapped mass correction factor, f_tm_corr} 查找表 array、{Normalized density breakpoints, f_tm_corr_nd_bpt} 指定断点、{Intake mass flow, f_mdot_intk} 查找表 array、{Exhaust cam phase breakpoints, f_mdot_air_ecp_bpt} 指定断点、{Trapped mass flow breakpoints, f_mdot_trpd_bpt} 指定断点、{Air mass flow correction factor, f_mdot_air_corr} 查找表 array、{Engine load breakpoints for air mass flow correction, f_mdot_air_corr_ld_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Engine speed breakpoints for air mass flow correction, f_mdot_air_n_bpt} 指定断点、{EGR flow time constant, tau_egr} 指定常量、{Intake system pressure ratio table, f_intksys_stdflow_pr} 指定表 array、{Standard mass flow rate breakpoints for intake pressure ratio, f_intksys_stdflow_bpt} 指定断点、{EGR valve standard mass flow rate, f_egr_stdflow} 指定表 vector、{EGR valve standard flow pressure ratio breakpoints, f_egr_stdflow_pr_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{EGR valve standard flow area percent breakpoints, f_egr_stdflow_egrap_bpt} 指定断点、{Torque table, f_tq_nl} 查找表、{Torque table speed breakpoints, f_tq_nl_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Crank angle pressure and torque} 启用曲轴角信号、{Cylinder pressure, f_crk_prs} 指定气缸压力表 L x M x、{Brake torque, f_crk_btq} 指定制动扭矩表 L x M x、{Speed breakpoints, f_crk_n_bpt} 指定速度断点、{Load breakpoints, f_crk_l_bpt} 指定负荷断点、{Crank angle breakpoints, f_crk_ang_bpt} 指定曲轴转角断点、{TDC compression angles by cylinder, f_crk_tdc_ang} 指定各气缸的 TDC 压缩角、{Inner torque table, f_tq_inr} 查找表 array、{Friction torque table, f_tq_fric} 查找表 array、{Engine temperature modifier on friction torque, f_fric_temp_mod} 查找表、{Engine temperature modifier breakpoints, f_fric_temp_bpt} 指定断点、{Pumping torque table, f_tq_pump} 查找表 array、{Optimal spark table, f_sa_opt} 查找表 array、{Inner torque load breakpoints, f_tq_inr_l_bpt} 指定断点、{Inner torque speed breakpoints, f_tq_inr_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Spark efficiency table, f_m_sa} 查找表 array、{Spark retard from optimal, f_del_sa_bpt} 指定断点、{Lambda efficiency, f_m_lam} 查找表 array、{Lambda breakpoints, f_m_lam_bpt} 指定断点、{Exhaust temperature table, f_t_exh} 查找表 array、{Load breakpoints, f_t_exh_l_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_t_exh_n_bpt} 指定断点，按实例取值。
